title: Resident Evil 4

custody.condition: Account-bound license on the archive Steam account. No physical media is part of this accession.

curatorNotes: Reserved for curator writing on the 2023 Resident Evil 4 remake once a fuller critical record is prepared.
collectionNotes: Ownership is digital only. The retained object is the Steam license. Official cover artwork has been entered from Steam library art; collection photography does not apply.

preservation.playableOn: Windows PC through Steam under archive custody
preservation.compatibility: Continued access requires the archive account, Steam’s support for the title, and Capcom / RE Engine services where the client requires them.
preservation.concerns: Account-bound digital holdings face platform dependency. Always-online checks and Capcom service policy remain principal risks. No offline installer is held.
preservation.knownRevisions: Steam remake release dated March 23, 2023. This accession records the licensed digital remake edition in custody, distinct from earlier Resident Evil 4 SKUs.
preservation.availability: Playable from the archive Steam library for as long as that license and the required services remain intact.

connections.futureReview: Reserved for future critical writing in Bloodsoaked Media.
